items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s basically Ornette [Coleman], Sonny [Murray], Albert Ayler, a free trio... That’s coming out of my relationship with Moses

ctx.x: Do you want to talk about that first?

That’s already ’70, ’71, and that’s coming out of the loft. That’s basically Ornette [Coleman], Sonny [Murray], Albert Ayler, a free trio. Some time, some changes, but basically free. That’s coming out of my relationship with Moses, which is my longest musical relationship. I mean Moses, we go back to ’61 – all right, so, ’62, a sweet sixteen party where I saw him, grabbed him. He – Moses is still one of the greats of all time. There’s another killer gem, an amazingly creative, killing drummer.
Is he still teaching in New England?
